record.hypothesis: Use L2-normalized item embedding lookups for both sequence inputs and positive, negative and candidate scoring, retaining the existing sqrt(hidden_units) input multiplier and tied embedding table. Keep padding exactly zero and use epsilon-safe normalization. Removing item-vector norm variation may improve generalization on sparse items while preserving the dot-product scoring mechanism, causal backbone, history policy, loss and optimizer. Update every lookup path and predictor construction consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: L2-normalize the shared item embedding lookups for sequence inputs, positive and negative targets, and candidates. This removes item-norm variation while retaining tied embeddings, the input scaling, causal convolutions, dot-product scoring, loss, and optimizer. Padding remains exactly zero. The generated predictor imports this same model class, preserving training/inference consistency without checkpoint shape changes.
